item.title: Ocean Lakes Family Campground Named 2017 “Mega Park of the Year” by the National Association of RV Parks & Campgrounds (arvc)
item.description: Ocean Lakes Family Campground in Myrtle Beach named Mega Park of the Year at arvc's national Outdoor Hospitality Conference & Expo for operations excellence.

item.title: Read Sasee's feature on Mary Emily Platt Jackson
item.description: Myrtle Beach's Sasee features Mary Emily Platt Jackson and her legacy of love described in the words of her five daughters. Co-founder of Ocean Lakes Family Campground and The Jackson Companies, read about how Mary Emily's influence and wisdom are still prevelant in the lives of her family and her businesses.

item.title: Greg Bender Promoted to Assistant GM
item.description: Ocean Lakes Family Campground, a division of The Jackson Companies, in Myrtle Beach, S.C., has promoted Greg Bender to Assistant General Manager. His new responsibilities include overall operations handled in Ocean Lakes’ Main Office and the Annual Lease Site Compliance Department.

item.title: Ocean Lakes Golf Cars in Myrtle Beach, SC Earns Club Car’s Black & Gold Elite Status, Ranks in the Top 10% Worldwide
item.description: Ocean Lakes Golf Cars has earned Club Car’s coveted Black & Gold Elite status for the second year.

item.title: Greg Bender Named Vice President and General Manager of Ocean Lakes Family Campground
item.description: Ocean Lakes Family Campground, a division of The Jackson Companies, has promoted Greg Bender to Vice President and General Manager. He is responsible for leading the overall operations of Ocean Lakes Family Campground upon Lance Thompson’s retirement on March 31, 2021.
